tracks.legalName: Dismissal After Probation and Vacation of a Pre-1984 Conviction, RCW 9.95.240
tracks.note: Drafted. The registry's correct_form build blocker answers itself for this track: no Washington Courts pattern form exists for RCW 9.95.240, the section prescribes no form, and the pleading is drafted on the RCW 9.94A.640 model. Pre-Sentencing Reform Act route only — offences committed before 1 July 1984.

tracks.legalName: Application for a Certificate of Restoration of Opportunity, RCW 9.97.020
tracks.note: Blocked as an official-form route. A complete statewide AOC CRO form set (CRO 01.0100, 01.0200, 01.0300, 01.0600, 01.0700) has existed since 2016 under the RCW 9.97.020(11) duty. Whether those forms are mandatory, pattern or optional is unresolved and decides the output strategy; separately, the five binaries have not been acquired, pinned or measured and no source-materialization receipt exists.
